    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    p = list(map(int, input[1:]))

    adj = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(1, n):
        adj[p[i-1]].append(i+1)

    def dfs(node):
        if not adj[node]:
            return 2
        child_results = [dfs(child) for child in adj[node]]
        total_ways = 1
        for ways in child_results:
            total_ways = (total_ways * ways) % MOD
        return (total_ways * 3) % MOD

    print(dfs(1))
